Know the role. Make the call.

Fantasy Mania turns production, volume, team role, scoring chances, efficiency and matchup evidence into one clear player profile — then separates long-term value from this week’s start decision.

What is the Mania Rating?
Mania Rating measures the strength of a player’s complete fantasy profile, not just last week’s points. It grades players against their own position using production, opportunity, team role, high-value touches/targets and efficiency. Missed games are excluded, and clearly shortened games are automatically downweighted so an early injury does not crush the player’s profile.

Week Start begins with that Mania profile, then adds the upcoming opponent, how similar players performed in that matchup, and recent role movement. That keeps “who is better?” separate from “who should I start this week?”
Blue is Fantasy Mania branding. Player grades use only green, yellow and red so the performance signal stays obvious.
